name: Mirkfallon Lake
summary: Mirkfallon Lake gathers wildlife beneath Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. Thunder lizards and wyverns crowd its banks, while aggressive slimes make its waters dangerous.

sections.title: A Highland Basin
sections.body: The slopes of the Stonetalon range send their runoff down to Mirkfallon Lake, at the range's heart. It lies between Webwinder Path to the south and Stonetalon Peak to the north. Thunder lizards come down from the highlands to drink, and wyverns leave their roosts overhead. Strange slimes bubble in the water, making the crossing hazardous for travelers.

sections.title: Crossroads of the Crag
sections.body: Paths meet across the lake basin. To the east, rocky tracks climb into Windshear Crag and the logging operations in its forested valleys. Northward, travelers climb toward night elven sanctums and tauren heights. Southward, the route skirts venomous spider hollows. Scouts and explorers crossing these contested mountains must reckon with dangers that shift around the lake.

faq.q: What creatures live around Mirkfallon Lake?
faq.answer: Thunder lizards roam the banks, and noxious ooze slimes inhabit the shallows. Mountain wyverns hunt around the basin and nest in the heights above.
Northward, the route climbs toward Stonetalon Peak. Southward, it descends through Webwinder Path. Rocky tracks to the east wind up into Windshear Crag.

faq.q: Is Mirkfallon Lake safe to fish in?
faq.answer: Sagefish and floating salvage tempt anglers, but aggressive slimes and wyverns frequent the shoreline. Quiet fishing is difficult there.

angles.text: As a druid, you see wild beasts around Mirkfallon Lake in a delicate balance. Mechanical axes advancing in the crag above press uncomfortably close.
